indexing.paragraph: The system shall allow Clients / Buyers to browse published digital artworks and view artwork details.
When a Client / Buyer opens the artwork gallery, all currently published artworks shall be displayed with their available details.
Helps buyers discover artists and select suitable digital artwork.
The system shall allow Clients / Buyers to submit digital art commission requests to Digital Artists.
When valid commission details are submitted, the system shall create a commission request and make it available to the selected Digital Artist.
Enables buyers to request customized digital artwork.
The system shall allow Digital Artists to accept, reject, and manage commission requests.
When an authorized Digital Artist updates a valid commission request, its status shall be updated and visible to the Client / Buyer.
Supports organized commission workflow and communication.
The system shall allow Digital Artists to upload completed artwork and apply a watermark before delivery.
When a valid artwork file is uploaded, the system shall apply the configured watermark and make the watermarked version available for delivery.
Protects artists' work from unauthorized reuse before final delivery.
The system shall allow Clients / Buyers to make payment and download the final watermarked artwork.
After a successful payment, the system shall confirm the transaction and allow the Client / Buyer to download the permitted artwork.
The system shall allow Digital Artists to publish completed digital artworks for browsing.
When an authorized Digital Artist selects Publish for a valid artwork, the artwork shall appear in the published artwork gallery.
Helps artists showcase their work and attract potential clients.
The system shall display artwork gallery, commission, and delivery pages within 3 seconds under normal operating conditions.
At least 9 out of 10 page-load tests shall complete within 3 seconds.
The system shall restrict commission-management, artwork-upload, watermarking, and publishing operations to authorized Digital Artists.
An unauthorized Client / Buyer attempting to perform restricted operations shall be denied access in 100% of test attempts.
Protects artwork and commission data from unauthorized modification.
The diagram models the two primary actors, their major interactions with the portal, and «include» / «extend» relationships.
Use Case: Submit Digital Art Commission
The Client / Buyer is authenticated in the Digital Art Commission & Watermarking Portal.
The selected Digital Artist is available for commissions.
A commission request is successfully created.
The request is associated with the selected Digital Artist and Client / Buyer.
The commission status is initialized for further processing.
The system displays a confirmation to the Client / Buyer.
The Client / Buyer opens the artwork gallery.
The system displays published digital artworks.
The Client / Buyer selects an artwork or Digital Artist.
The system displays the relevant artwork and commission information.
The Client / Buyer selects the commission option.
The system validates the commission details.
The Client / Buyer submits the commission request.
The system creates the commission request and assigns it to the selected Digital Artist.
The system displays a confirmation message indicating that the request was submitted successfully.
AF-01: Commission Request Cannot Be Submitted
The Client / Buyer submits the commission request.
The system detects missing or invalid required information.
The system does not create the commission request.
The system displays a message identifying the required correction.
The Client / Buyer is returned to the commission form.
Use Case: Apply Watermark to Artwork
Brief Flow: The Digital Artist uploads completed artwork → the system validates the file → the system applies the configured watermark → the watermarked artwork is stored for protected delivery.
